title: Site Build Packet
description: The complete input to a site build. Compiled by Agent 04 from prospect + enrichment + report. Consumed by the v5 factory (lane routing via tier) or by Lovable PROMPT A/B.

tier.description: cinematic_single -> PROMPT A / v5 single-page lane. premier_hub -> PROMPT B / 5-8 page authority lane.

engine.description: Which build engine executes this packet.

palette.description: Extracted from real brand evidence. Never invented against evidence.

photo_urls.description: Owner/public business photos, rescued through content-rescue pipelines before placement.

proof.description: Only verifiable claims. Each entry MUST carry a source. Empty array is acceptable.

competitor_context.description: PRIVATE — informs copy strategy, never rendered verbatim

widget.description: One vertical-specific conversion widget id (e.g. quote-estimator, booking, before-after-slider)

banned_copy_check.description: Compiler asserts no internal/banned language entered the packet copy fields.

report_url.description: The visibility report tied to this prospect — used in follow-up, never in public site copy.
